name: Extract sanitizeCell helper and refactor 3 CSV/TSV/Pipe parsers
description: Deduplicate cell cleaning logic across parseCsv, parseTsv, and parsePipeSeparated into an exported sanitizeCell function in src/parser.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: In src/parser.ts, parseCsv, parseTsv, and parsePipeSeparated all duplicate cell sanitization logic (trimming whitespace and unescaping wrapped quotes). Extract this into an exported helper function sanitizeCell(cell: string): string, and refactor the three parsers to call it. Ensure existing tests and the new sanitizeCell tests pass.

acceptance_criteria: parseCsv, parseTsv, and parsePipeSeparated call sanitizeCell
Behavior of all three parsers is strictly preserved
